messages:
tayla-recruiter: Quick routing needed for Mateo (Backend SWE II). Manager Jordan requests start 2026-03-15. Proposed comp: base $172,000 + $8,000 sign-on. Band S3. Candidate asks benefits to start day one. Need approvals for base > band and benefits timing. cc @anna-people-ops @ben-finance
anna-people-ops: Thanks Tayla. Quick Qs: backfill or new headcount? any relocation/visa? Also note: if base > band cap it triggers comp committee review which can add ~5 business days. Payroll/benefits cutoffs?
jordan-engineering: Backfill for Srinivas. No relocation or visa. Manager would like candidate onboard by 3/15 because of sprint ramp. Jordan ok with mixing sign-on to avoid committee if that helps.
ben-finance: Band S3 cap is $170,000 per current comp table. Payroll note: March mid-cycle payroll cutoff is 2026-03-09; benefits enrollment HRIS cutoff is 2026-03-11 to get 3/15 effective date. If we go to comp committee it may push start beyond those dates.
comp-approvals-bot: Policy lookup: Band S3 base cap = $170,000. Base > cap => comp committee required (ref: comp-guidelines/s3). One-time sign-on does not count toward base cap.
tayla-recruiter: Candidate prefers full sign-on upfront but ok with split. Manager Jordan prefers avoid comp committee. Proposed adjustment: base = $170k, sign-on $10k (increase from $8k) split 6k/4k. Will candidate accept increased sign-on?
jordan-engineering: Jordan confirms cost center sign-off for up to $10k sign-on. Prefer to keep start 3/15.
ben-finance: Finance preference: cap base at $170k to avoid committee and move remainder into one-time sign-on. Approve sign-on up to $10k with split 6k/4k (first payroll + 30 days) provided HRIS and cost center timelines met. Note: upfront payment in first payroll requires fully executed offer and HRIS record before 2026-03-09 cutoff.
anna-people-ops: Routing plan: 1) Manager approved. 2) Finance approves sign-on structure (ben ack). 3) People Ops can approve benefits effective 2026-03-15 contingent on HRIS entry by 2026-03-11 and signed offer by 2026-03-08. Tayla, please confirm final numbers for offer language.
tayla-recruiter: Confirming offer language: base $170,000, sign-on $10,000 split 6k on first payroll, 4k after 30 days, start 2026-03-15. Benefits effective 2026-03-15 pending HRIS entry by 2026-03-11 and signed offer by 2026-03-08. Candidate verbally accepts these terms.
comp-approvals-bot: Recording approval path: manager -> finance -> people ops (conditional). No comp committee required.
ben-finance: Finance recorded cost to ENG-BE-01. Approve moving forward.
anna-people-ops: People Ops conditional approval noted. I'll add the conditional wording to the offer template and mark in Greenhouse.
tayla-recruiter: Sending offer now. Will update when signed and when HRIS hire record created. Thanks all :pray:
